name: AIAgentWorkNote
description: AIAgentWorkNote is a lightweight inline disclosure atom used in chat threads when the agent is actively working, planning, checking context, or summarizing what it is about to do. It gives the user sh
intent: Quiet, trustworthy transparency. The agent shows what it is doing without exposing private reasoning.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.

props.name: label
props.hint: Override the disclosure label. Defaults to STATUS_LABEL[status].

props.name: status
props.hint: Drives the default label and visual state. Options: idle \

props.name: content
props.hint: Prose note shown in the expanded body.

props.name: items
props.hint: Numbered list items shown in the expanded body.

props.name: icon
props.hint: Optional leading icon to the left of the label.

props.name: hideable
props.hint: Show a Hide link next to the label.

props.name: showViewTrace
props.hint: Show "View trace →" link in expanded body.

props.name: loading
props.hint: Show loading dots inline when status=active.

props.name: onToggle
props.hint: Called when the user toggles expand/collapse.

props.name: onHide
props.hint: Called when the user clicks Hide.

props.name: onViewTrace
props.hint: Called when the user clicks View trace.

forbiddenUsage: Do not use for every response — only when working transparency is needed
Do not use for final recommendation rationale — use ai-rationale-panel instead
Do not use as a full process trace — use ai-reasoning-trace instead
Do not expose hidden chain-of-thought or system prompts
Do not use when a simple loading indicator is enough
Do not use for standard product notifications
